label: Every being NECESSARY_PER_SE_2 is the maximal being of the…, via NECESSARY_PER_SE_2 is MAXIME_ENS_1
meaning: The ways converge (handoff 2026-10-24 on #143): the tertia via's per se necessary being is the quarta via's maximal being. If it were other than the maximum, the maximum would cause its being (genus principle at esse, given that a necessary being has being) and so its necessity, against its being necessary per se. Same shape as AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-FIRST-MOVER-IS-MAXIME-ENS. The two cross-vocabulary bridges are open premises, supported by SCG I.15 [5] (which identifies the first being necessary through itself with God 'since He is the first cause'). The countermodel withoutNecessityBridgeTwoFirsts shows the causing-necessity bridge is needed. With AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-QUARTA-VIA (a maximum exists) and AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-MAXIME-ENS-IS-GOD (or its fuller-description version, #194) the per se necessary being would be God; no result yet verifies that composition. This addresses candidate AQUINAS-NECESSARY-PER-SE-TO-STAGE-ONE.
